# Konooz Al-Ahram Eye Hospital

> Official website and patient portal of Konooz Al-Ahram Eye & Surgery Hospital in Benghazi, Libya. A bilingual (Arabic-first, RTL) Next.js 15 site offering department information, surgical cost estimates, vision self-screening tools, appointment booking via WhatsApp handoff, and a device-local patient portal.

Key facts:

- Arabic is the default language; English is available via the header switcher or `?lang=en` deep links.
- Patient profile data is stored **only in the visitor's browser** — nothing is transmitted to a server, and no feature described on this site sends data automatically.
- Booking requests open a pre-filled WhatsApp draft that the user sends themselves.
- Built with Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript strict mode, and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Pages

- [Home](https://konozealahram-eye.ly/): single-page bilingual site — departments, doctors, services, booking, patient portal, operations dashboard.
